drhp.business: Premier Limited operates in a single segment, engineering and capital goods, historically manufacturing CNC machines including High Speed Gear Hobbing machines and VTL (Vertical Turret Lathe) machines below 1000 mm table size for automobile, engineering, railways and defence customers. The company's operations remained suspended since 3 March 2020 due to a shortage of working capital and inability to complete installation and commissioning of machines at its Chakan plant, and it is now under CIRP.
drhp.expansion: No expansion activity: the company was unable to complete installation and commissioning of machines at the Chakan plant due to a shortage of working capital, and there was no new product development during the year under review; the company remains under CIRP.

litigation.note: The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) before the NCLT, Mumbai Bench, effective 29 January 2021, initiated on a petition by Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited; the Labour Union has filed various legal cases in different courts for different issues (per MD&A Risk and Concerns / Human Resources sections).

Per the Ken Research Report the India Dies and Moulds Market was valued at INR 45,400 crore in FY'25 and is projected to grow at an 11.5% CAGR to FY'30F, with Automotive Moulds the largest application at INR 25.2 thousand crore in FY'25 and B2B/OEM the dominant distribution channel.
